usedFor: monday.com tracks the work on boards and Craft is where you write the documents around it. An “Item Column Value Changes” in monday.com can run “Create Document” in Craft, so a status moving on a board starts a doc.

bestTemplate.name: “Item Column Value Changes” in monday.com, then “Create Document” in Craft
bestTemplate.why: A column value changing, such as a status, is a clear moment for a brief or a notes page. “Create Document” puts it in a folder, Unsorted or Templates, with starting content.

watchOut: “Item Column Value Changes” runs on every update to a column on the board, so the same item can make several documents. “New User Joins” is polling.
